messages.author: f23936ce69c6edbd
messages.subject: Questions MethylKit
parts:
Hello,

As I am currently trying to use MethylKit with RRBS data I have some
questions and would be very thankful for answers.
First, I don't really know why I need to involve a Reference Assembly
or Annotation Data for the program. The manual says, that these can be
downloaded from the UCSC homepage, but this page does not have any
plant genomes and I used plant DNA for sequencing. So, my question is,
can I just omit the assembly/annotation for the analysis with
methylkit? And if not, can I also download my data from another page?
and how to integrate it then into the program? The manual only says,
that the assembly should be saved as text file but not if any further
steps are necessary to integrate it into the program?
Second, can I read in a methylation level call from bsseeker2 just as
it is? The manual says, "a typical methylation call file looks like
this..." The output file from bsseeker2 looks similar, but clearly
isn't the same, so do I have to convert it to exactly the example
given in the manual?
I am not very advanced in bioinformatics, so please excuse if my
questions are not properly posed or seem shallow.
It would be really nice, if you could give me some advice.
Thanks a lot in advanve!

Svenja

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Questions MethylKit
parts:
The manual says, that these can be  
downloaded from the UCSC homepage, but this page does not have any  
plant genomes and I used plant DNA for sequencing. So, my question is,  
can I just omit the assembly/annotation for the analysis with  
methylkit?
You can run without annotation data.
And if not, can I also download my data from another page?
Check the forum, there has been discussion about this, some people managed get Arabidopsis annotation.

and how to integrate it then into the program? The manual only says,  
that the assembly should be saved as text file but not if any further  
steps are necessary to integrate it into the program?
Assembly is just a string an not that important. Annotation should be a text file in BED format. If it is not in BED format, you have to convert the file to BED format yourself.

Second, can I read in a methylation level call from bsseeker2 just as  
it is? The manual says, "a typical methylation call file looks like  
this..." The output file from bsseeker2 looks similar, but clearly  
isn't the same, so do I have to convert it to exactly the example  
given in the manual?

there are ways to read in generic text files using methylKit. see this example
http://zvfak.blogspot.de/2012/10/how-to-read-bsmap-methylation-ratio.html

I am not very advanced in bioinformatics, so please excuse if my  
questions are not properly posed or seem shallow.
It would be really nice, if you could give me some advice.
Thanks a lot in advanve!

Svenja

messages.author: d12c43f871e3aaf5
messages.subject: Re: Questions MethylKit
parts:
Hello Svenja,

Glad that you use BS-Seeker2. Recently, we have developed new package for downstream analysis after BS-Seeker2, processing CGmap and ATCGmap formats directly.

The software name is CGmapTools (https://cgmaptools.github.io), which have 39 functions for processing DNA methylations, and wokring on DNA methylaiton analysis, coverage analysis, SNV anlaysis and ASM analysis

Hope you find CGmapTools useful!

Best,
Weilong Guo
